description: Our mission is to educate, inspire and guide our clients to make the choices that will benefit and enrich our lives, our places and our planet. We design with instinct, impact and intelligence to create architecture that is a synthesis of experiential, environmental & technological design. We use a mix of rigorous thinking and radical creativity to explore and push the boundaries of architecture. We don’t constrain ourselves to what’s gone before, but look for new, better and original ways to do things: in our ideas; in our processes; in the materials we use; in the levels of wellbeing we can achieve in the built environment and beyond. This uncompromising outlook means being brave, being bold, and being ready to question the status quo. We push and challenge our clients, the industry and technology, constantly striving to expand the possibilities of design for living and to bring more colour to the world we inhabit. Our architectural expertise and services cover a wide range of sectors all tied together by the desire and commitment to create exemplary buildings that have been designed with the user at the heart. description: Emrys has developed a portfolio of high-profile cultural, residential and commercial buildings peppered with tiny, quirky projects – all approached with the same intellectual curiosity, attention to detail, and flair. We are a practice with a purpose. Emrys has a real sense of excitement, an understanding that the ethos that underpins our work is perfectly in tune with the times. We value on-going relationships over one-off quick-fix deals; lasting performance over short-term gain. Our purpose is to deliver buildings that respect the environment, enrich their context, and withstand the test of time. But perhaps most of all, our purpose is to get to know our clients, to understand how they want to live and work, and to help them to realise their dreams. Emrys is driven by a belief that time spent listening to clients, exploring ideas, on teaching, or learning, is never wasted time. That investment in thought, dialogue, design and pushing the boundaries of standard process pays for itself several times over in terms of reduced build and running costs, efficient delivery, added value and quality of results. name: Godsmark Architecture

description: Architecture is not about bricks and mortar it is about people. How people live, how they work, how they relax and how they enjoy life. Our work is based on a foundation of research. This can be as simple as watching how clients use their house or as complicated as arriving at innovative technical solutions to problems that allow us to make buildings work for you. We apply this research in a collaborative way working with clients and end users to arrive at building solutions which the users are a part of. We recognise that buildings are never “complete” but will continue to change throughout their lives. We aim to building in flexibility which allows this to happen. We aim to design buildings which are simple to read, elegantly conceived and above all detailed with technical prowess and sophistication. The work of the practice is underpinned by a strong conviction in the value of creative design, not by a desire to specialise in any single sector. Our strength lies in our ability to apply a systematic design process regardless of programme or location. We apply an inclusive and collaborative approach fostering creative dialogue with clients, consultant teams, contractors and end users. We develop our designs to maximise space and light; we aspire to deliver something uplifting and unique. We seek out appropriate technologies for construction, the electrical, mechanical, ventilation and heating strategies to provide an energy efficient and long-lasting solution to every brief. As well as new build we have a strong track record of working on old and listed buildings. Address Unit 9, Shoreditch Town Hall, 380 Old Street, London, EC1V 9LT Contact Timothy Godsmark Instagram godsmarkarchitecture

name: Julian Cowie Architects
description: Julian Cowie Architects is a London based architecture studio founded in 1996. The practice works on a range of residential, commercial and civic projects providing full architectural, interior design and masterplanning services for both public and private sectors. Our range of completed projects includes hotels, private houses, residential developments, offices, retail, transport and the extension and conversion of historic buildings. Our design is based on a consistent approach rather than a particular style with each scheme a unique response to site, context and our clients brief. We aim to achieve simple, elegant and practical solutions through intensive discussion with our clients and consultant team. Many of our projects involve the insertion of new uses within complicated urban sites and often have difficult planning histories. We pride ourselves on creating an imaginative and sensitive architectural response which is borne out in our success in achieving planning consent and the quality of our built work. We typically work on a small number of projects at any one time. This allows for great continuity and personal involvement. Unlike many practices, we have a policy of a single project architect following each scheme through from the first meeting to detail design, construction and completion. The practice director is involved in all stages of the design and attends all client and design team meetings in tandem with the project architect. We believe this structure has allowed us to develop strong, long term relationships with our clients and enhance the rigorous quality of our completed buildings. Addresses 70-74 Cowcross Street, London, EC1M 6EJ Green Farm, West End, Bitteswell, Lutterworth, LE17 4SE Contact Julian Cowie
